description: Unit test implementation for oidmap data structure, testing initialization, cleanup, replace, get, remove, and iteration functions.

methods.name: test_oidmap__initialize
methods.description: Initializes the oidmap and populates it with predefined key-value pairs.

methods.name: test_oidmap__replace
methods.description: Replaces entries in the oidmap and verifies previous values.

methods.name: test_oidmap__get
methods.description: Retrieves entries from the oidmap and verifies their contents.

methods.name: test_oidmap__remove
methods.description: Removes entries from the oidmap and verifies removal.

methods.name: test_oidmap__iterate
methods.description: Iterates over the oidmap entries and verifies correctness.

methods.name: key_val_contains
methods.description: Checks if an entry's oid matches any in the key_val array and updates the seen array.
